description: Generate and auto-save pseudo-triad distance figure and mapping CSV
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.DataFrame([
 ["Nucleophile Ser","Ser189 (GDSAG)","Ser725","Ser191 (GDSSG)","Ser","conserved"],
 ["Acid Asp","Asp343","Asp994","Asp289","Asp","conserved"],
 ["General-base His","His373","His1024","Val319","Val","LOST (His->Val)"],
 ["Oxyanion (HGG loop)","HGG","HGG","His113 / HGG","His","conserved"],
], columns=["Catalytic element","AADAC active-site","HSL active-site","GID1A residue (2ZSH)","GID1A aa","Status"])
for d in ["/data","/tmp"]:
    df.to_csv(d+"/gid1a_triad_mapping.csv",index=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
labels=["His113 NE2","His113 ND1","His119 NE2","His119 ND1","Val319 CB"]
dists=[8.51,9.51,9.43,9.98,7.95]
ax.bar(labels,dists,color=["#cc5555"]*4+["#777777"])
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="green",label="max catalytic His-N…Ser-OG (~3.5 Å)")
ax.set_ylabel("Distance to Ser191 OG (Å) in 2ZSH")
ax.set_title("AtGID1A (2ZSH): no His positioned to activate Ser191 nucleophile")
ax.legend(); plt.xticks(rotation=15); plt.tight_layout()
for d in ["/data","/tmp"]:
    plt.savefig(d+"/gid1a_pseudotriad_2ZSH.png",dpi=130)
plt.show()
print("saved")
